# Culinaria Italia

> > Authentic Italian recipes and regional culinary traditions from Puglia, Lazio, Sicily, and beyond

Culinaria Italia is a culinary blog dedicated to authentic Italian cooking, featuring traditional recipes from regional cuisines across Italy. The site emphasizes proper techniques and ingredients endorsed by institutions like the Accademia Italiana della Cucina, with particular focus on Southern Italian dishes from Puglia, Bari, and Brindisi, showcasing pasta, seafood, and classic preparations with ingredients like Parmigiano Reggiano, Grana Padano, and pecorino.

## Key Topics

- Italian regional cuisine
- Puglia and Bari specialties
- Authentic Italian recipes
- Parmigiano Reggiano
- Grana Padano
- Pecorino cheese
- Southern Italian cooking
- Seafood dishes
- Pasta preparations
- Accademia Italiana della Cucina
- Traditional Italian techniques
- Brindisi cuisine
- Lazio recipes
- Italian appetizers and antipasti

## Iconic Italian Pasta Dishes

- [Carbonara – Authentic recipe](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/07/19/carbonara-authentic-recipe): Authentic Carbonara from Lazio by Accademia Italiana della Cucina (no cream)
- [Tagliatelle with artichokes and anchovies](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/01/16/tagliatelle-with-artichokes-and-anchovies): Tagliatelle con carciofi e acciughe with fresh artichokes and anchovies
- [Gnocchetti sardi with mussels](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2007/12/16/gnocchetti-sardi-with-mussels): Gnocchetti sardi pasta with mussels in semi-soup style
- [Rigatoni with basil and tomatoes](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2007/12/06/rigatoni-with-basil-and-tomatoes): Vegan baked rigatoni with fresh basil and tomatoes

## Puglia and Southern Italian Specialties

- [Brindisi fish soup](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/04/16/brindisi-fish-soup): Zuppa di pesce alla Brindisina recipe from Brindisi with fish market trip
- [Tiella alla Barese](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/04/26/tiella-alla-barese): Tiella recipe from Bari with mussels, rice, and potatoes
- [Pettole](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2013/06/18/pettole): Pettole (zeppole) sweet/savory doughnuts from Puglia and Basilicata
- [Grilled aubergines](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/06/15/grilled-aubergines): Melanzane arrostite grilled aubergines from Puglia with mint and garlic
- [Easter lamb](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/03/22/easter-lamb): Agnello di Pasqua: Pugliese Easter lamb with eggs, peas, and pecorino

## Appetizers and Small Plates

- [Bagna cauda](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2013/03/17/bagna-cauda): Bagna caôda from Piemonte: warm anchovy and garlic dip for vegetables
- [Figs and ham](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2012/07/09/figs-and-ham): Roselline di prosciutto: Bari-style figs with prosciutto crudo appetizer
- [Sausages in tomato sauce](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2008/07/16/sausages-in-tomato-sauce): Salsicce al pomodoro recipe with Italian sausages as antipasto
- [Sun dried tomato struzzichini](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2010/02/02/sun-dried-tomato-struzzichini): Struzzichini aperitivo snacks with sun-dried tomatoes from Lombardy

## Main Courses and Hearty Dishes

- [Polpette with Gorgonzola](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2007/11/18/polpette-with-gorgonzola): Italian polpette (meatballs) with Gorgonzola and Parmigiano Reggiano
- [Grilled cuttlefish](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2007/11/17/41): Grilled cuttlefish recipe with homemade chilli oil
- [Stuffed cabbage leaves](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2013/03/24/stuffed-cabbage-leaves): Involtini di verza stuffed cabbage with rice and Parmigiano Reggiano
- [Potato pizza with ham and spinach](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2013/04/21/potato-pizza-with-ham-and-spinach): Pizza di patate from Bari with ham, spinach, and scamorza cheese

## Frozen Desserts and Sweets

- [Coffee granita](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2012/04/03/coffee-granita): Sicilian coffee granita with espresso served with cream
- [Limoncello granita](https://culinariaitalia.wordpress.com/2012/05/04/limoncello-granita): Limoncello granita: Southern Italian frozen dessert with lemon liqueur
